supplementary_source_review.result: Static copy uses typed keys or nativeText. Email-code interpolation is repaired. SDK error text is bounded. Inputs remain opaque.

Titles and buttons use typed keys/resources. Authenticity claim templates use the selected UI locale at presentation; existing hadith/collection/unverified decisions are unchanged. Autonyms, source text, attribution, license names and source names stay opaque. A1/A3 content gates remain open.
Greeting, progress, counts, conditionals and action names resolve the UI locale. Dates use locale formatters. Reference/title data and user names stay opaque.

Loading, navigation/menu cards, icon names, bookmark fallbacks, accessibility markers/grades and report/evidence errors are traced to localized boundaries. Volume/chapter/source/user text stays opaque. The unused ReaderSheetSectionLabel has no runtime caller. Authenticity templates are localized at presentation; the legacy model formatter is not a product UI caller.
Filters, empty guidance, confirmation/Undo and timestamps retain earlier native evidence. Folder names, notes and preview content remain opaque.

Root headers/summaries/account fallbacks and destination notices are traced to selected-locale renderers. Autonyms, time strings, cache sizes, names, emails and external price fields remain data. Store/export/account callbacks and fences are unchanged.
Own guidance and status use fixed keys. Known error guidance is localized; arbitrary diagnostics use a bounded fallback. Source citations and filenames remain verbatim.
Owned labels and failure notices are localized. Store-provided prices and purchase/account state are preserved. Actual store/annual-total acceptance stays open.
Retain previous A4 fifteen-locale dictionaries, plural and backend-notification evidence. Physical scheduling/widget acceptance stays open.

supplementary_source_review.surface: Core UI wrappers and variable text
supplementary_source_review.result: Typed SwiftUI labels, nativeText helpers, prelocalized values and opaque data cover remaining variable Text arguments. Root/model-backed wrappers and semantic names were reviewed separately from the lexical report.
